title: Total cohomology of the specified Cech resolution double complex
statement: Let C be a category with v-small Hom sets and finite wide pullbacks, J a Grothendieck topology with sheafification for v-small abelian groups, F an abelian sheaf, I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], X an object of C, and pi_i : U_i → X a family indexed by a type in universe v. Assume Ext in abelian sheaves can be computed in universe v, and the sieve generated by the family is covering in J. For every n ≥ 0, the degree-n homology of the total complex of D [def-sc-cech-resolution-double-complex] is isomorphic to H^n(X,F) [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. This statement concerns a specified resolution and double complex and asserts no column-cohomology identification.

proof.text: Apply injective_cech_total_sections to I.cocomplex, whose terms are injective by the injective-resolution instance. This identifies total homology with homology of the integer section complex. The double complex in its statement unfolds to Sheaf.cechResolutionDoubleComplex I X pi.

Apply the proved resolution_section_cohomology to I and X. It identifies the section-complex homology with F.H' n X by the free-abelian sheafification/Yoneda adjunction and Mathlib computation of Ext. Compose the two isomorphisms in Lean.

theorem Sheaf.cechResolutionDoubleComplex_total
    {F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}} (I : InjectiveResolution F) (X : C)
    {ι : Type v} {U : ι → C} (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows U π ∈ J X) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (((Sheaf.cechResolutionDoubleComplex I X π).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n ≅ F.H' n X)
